about: What the engine is missing, found while building (a piece of the bar) or in the review of 2026-11-05. side: core, visual, tools. status: open or closed (with the piece or commit that closed it). Read by tools/dashboard.py for the Loop3D Workshop dashboard.

gaps.gap: A project is a list of scenes in project.json, not a .looped project file
Scene names must differ across every project (a link is #scene, not project and scene)
Samples, Showcase and Ardane still use project.json, not a cover page
No loading once by name: models, pictures and sounds are found by file each time
Sound only from the synth: no music or voices from files
Collisions and touches don't reach scripts as events
World words and visual words share one file
The world's description lives beside the film renderer
The live renderer mixes everyday drawing and the GPU path tracer
Many lamps cost too much on the phone (the light grid is parked)
No frame blending: soft edges and shimmer
The editor can't save moved things back to the script
Helpers in three languages (C++, Python, JavaScript)
Film grain fizzed on the phone
Everything drawn every frame, seen or not
Each pixel lit once per surface over it
